title: Validate Stack Sequences
summary: Given two integer arrays, pushed and popped, each containing distinct values, determine whether the popped sequence can be achieved through a series of push and pop operations starting from an empty stack.
statement: Given two integer arrays, pushed and popped, each containing distinct values, determine whether the popped sequence can be achieved through a series of push and pop operations starting from an empty stack. Return true if the sequence is valid, otherwise return false.
constraints: pushed and popped are permutations of the same distinct values.
Return whether popped can be produced by pushes in pushed order and arbitrary pops.
hints: When the requested next pop is available at the stack top, delaying it is never useful.
Push each value, then greedily pop matching requested values.
Advance popped pointer while stack[-1] equals popped[j].
Every legal execution can make these eager pops; remaining stack means the target order was blocked.
editorial: Every legal execution can make these eager pops; remaining stack means the target order was blocked.

tests.explanation: Push through four, pop four, then continue to realize the sequence.
After popping one, value two blocks the requested one, so it is impossible.
